items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I came back and I joined... into the Henrietta School in the community, and met Miss Isabel Stiller.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a piano. And they had a... I would play 'Yes, We Have No Bananas', and I had a little bass... I used to imitate, you know.
Then we moved uptown... I didn't have any formal training then, there... But then I came back and I joined... into the Henrietta School in the community, and met Miss Isabel Stiller.
